text:
DRAFT – requires salesperson approval – availability unconfirmed
Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. As specified, we can't meet this request. The tool treated it as a single group of 30 people, and our largest room, the Loft, holds at most 24. The Studio holds at most 12. Your plan of two sessions of 15 would be two separate bookings, and I haven't been able to price that setup. For now I have only checked the group as a whole.

There is one alternative. You would have to agree to it, and it means giving something up: the group would be reduced from 30 to at most 24 people. It would use the Loft with a coffee break for each attendee. Our bookings are 4 hours, and I assumed that length because you didn't state one.



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft + Coffee break | 24 | €612 | headcount reduced from 30 to at most 24 |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



The prices shown cover ONE booking only. If you go ahead with two sessions, the second booking still has to be priced separately. The table should not be read as the total for the whole event. Please also tell us whether you want to keep the two sessions of 15 or would prefer a different split. Then we can look at how to price it properly.

Since you mentioned the same day, please note that availability has to be checked separately. Nothing is held or promised by this email. Our listed prices are fixed, and we can't offer price reductions.

Please get in touch if you'd like to go ahead with the alternative or change the plan.

Kind regards
